title: A carbon–nitrogen triple bond
hook: Inspect the bonds and identify the functional group.

knows: Lines in a structural formula represent chemical bonds.
doesNotKnow: A nitrile contains a carbon–nitrogen triple bond, represented here by –C≡N.

misconception: Every molecule with the same element contains the same functional group.
objective: Recognize the stated functional group from condensed structural connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structure and explanation: Which listed functional group best describes the distinctive group in this condensed structural diagram? This diagram represents acetonitrile. A nitrile contains a carbon–nitrogen triple bond, represented here by –C≡N. Lines show bonds; grouped labels such as CH₃ are condensed notation.
The diagram is a condensed 2D structural representation, not a model of molecular geometry.
Recall: Which group is illustrated in the acetonitrile example? A nitrile contains a carbon–nitrogen triple bond, represented here by –C≡N.
